subject: MANAGER DISPOSITION: fail-safe host lifecycle contract READY_FOR_PRIMARY
body: Manager independently reviewed the host-lifecycle lane at HEAD 1cf46d7505ee74a8f4434be6d77a890ddce57ac1. All four research artifact hashes verified and the reference gate independently reran 9/9 PASS. Official OpenAI Help currently confirms pin-chat and archive-chat exist as user-facing host features, while this manager runtime exposes no callable pin/archive conversation action, no guaranteed session-end callback, no exact pre-first-turn role injection primitive, and no exact chat-identity restore action. READY_FOR_PRIMARY for the fail-safe contract: separate host_feature_state from agent_invocation_state; UI support without callable action => MANUAL_ACTION_REQUIRED; request never equals verified completion; required persistence/backup failure blocks archival eligibility; old Primary archive also requires singleton release/supersession; current safe bootstrap is POST_START_DISCOVERY_BOOTSTRAP; state rehydration cannot claim CHAT_IDENTITY_RESTORED. This explicitly does NOT claim self-pin/self-archive automation is currently possible.
